title: Viva Engage: My Team audiences and flexible targeting for Storyline Announcements
summary: The briefing's rollout dates, licensing qualifications and documented control paths are supported. The governance checklist includes checking organisational data without a corresponding control row, a minor completeness issue.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions

claims.quote: This capability requires the Viva Suite license.

claims.claim: Learn grants identified leaders with the Communities and Communications service plan access to announcements, leadership corner, campaigns and AMAs.
claims.quote: Identified leaders with a license to the Viva Engage Communities and Communications service plan have access to storyline announcements, leadership corner, campaigns, and AMAs.

claims.claim: Recipients need the Communities and Communications service plan for Outlook and Teams announcement notifications, not a stated premium viewing requirement.
claims.quote: To receive announcement notifications through Outlook and Microsoft Teams, you’ll need a license to the Viva Engage Communities and Communications service plan.

claims.claim: The prerequisite premium plans use per-user licensing.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: No separate flexible-targeting price, credit rate or meter is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage flexible targeting pricing license meter. Opened Microsoft Viva pricing, Viva Engage setup requirements, and Storyline announcements; these document premium plans, not a separate targeting meter or price.

claims.claim: Leaders, delegates, delegate managers and corporate communicators can post Storyline Announcements.
claims.quote: Leaders, leaders' delegates, delegate managers, and corporate communicators can post announcements.

claims.claim: Users must be identified as leaders to post leadership announcements.
claims.quote: Users identified as leaders in Viva Engage with a configured audience can post announcements.

claims.where: Scope: Who uses it; Scope: Prerequisites
claims.claim: Existing Learn and Support guidance requires audience configuration for storyline announcements.
claims.quote: Leader identification and audience management are required for other premium features to work successfully, including storyline announcements, leadership corner, campaigns, and analytics.

claims.claim: Learn states that a leader can add up to 40 audiences.
claims.quote: A leader can add up to 40 audiences.

claims.claim: Application of the 40-audience limit to new saved audiences is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage saved audiences administrator limit audit. Opened leadership-identification and Storyline announcements; the former states 40 audiences, while the new targeting documentation gives no saved-audience limit.

claims.claim: The audience-management path is Feature management > Leadership identification and audiences > Manage leaders > leader (pencil icon) > Manage audiences.
claims.quote: On the Feature management tab, select Leadership identification and audiences to go to the Manage leaders page. ... find the leader’s row and select the pencil icon ... The Manage audiences page appears

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell equivalent for leader identification and audience configuration is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage leader audience management Microsoft Graph REST PowerShell API activity log. Opened leadership-identification and Graph engagement-api-overview beta; no leader/audience configuration API appeared.

claims.claim: The leader configures delegates in the Engage Teams app through the ellipsis menu beside their profile picture > Delegate management.
claims.quote: In the Engage Teams application, select the ellipsis (...) menu next to your profile picture in the upper-right corner ... Select Delegate management.

claims.claim: No API equivalent for Engage delegate management is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage delegate management Microsoft Graph REST API PowerShell. Opened leadership-identification and Graph engagement-api-overview beta; found administrative-role APIs, not leader delegate management.

claims.claim: Feature management > Storyline > Advanced Settings > Edit > Specify storyline creators limits who has a storyline feed and can create posts.
claims.quote: go to Feature management > Storyline. ... Select Edit in Advanced Settings. ... Switch Specify storyline creators to Eligible users from selected group.

claims.claim: No automation equivalent for Specify storyline creators is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage Specify storyline creators settings API PowerShell Graph. Opened eac-storyline and Graph engagement-api-overview beta; results documented UI restrictions and follow APIs, not creator-setting automation.

claims.where: controls[3].ui; controls[3].note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The activity log on Manage leaders, reached through Leadership identification and audiences, covers leader and audience changes over the past 30 days.
claims.quote: To track changes to leaders and their audiences over the past 30 days, use the activity log available on the Manage Leaders page.

claims.claim: No API equivalent for the Manage leaders activity log is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage leader audience management Microsoft Graph REST PowerShell API activity log. Opened leadership-identification and Graph engagement-api-overview beta; general audit results did not document this activity-log API.

claims.where: controls[4]; Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No tenant-wide UI or API switch specifically disabling My Team or publish-time targeting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage My Team flexible targeting tenant admin disable saved audiences Entire organization limit pricing meter; Viva Engage My Team disable audiences. Opened leadership-identification, eac-storyline, Storyline announcements and Graph overview; no targeting-specific switch found.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Only Engage admins, verified admins, network admins and corporate communicators can enable Entire organization for pre-configured audiences.
claims.quote: Leaders and delegate managers can't enable this option. Only Engage admins, Viva Engage verified admins, Viva Engage network admins, and corporate communicators can allow leaders to reach the entire organization.

claims.claim: Delegate managers can configure a leader's audiences.
claims.quote: A delegate manager can also configure a leader’s audiences and assign more delegates or delegate managers.

claims.claim: Delegate managers can assign further delegates.
claims.quote: A delegate manager can also configure a leader’s audiences and assign more delegates or delegate managers.

claims.claim: Engage admins, verified admins, network admins, corporate communicators, leaders and their delegate managers can edit leader audiences.
claims.quote: This task is for the Engage admin, Viva Engage verified admin, Viva Engage network admin, corporate communicator, and leader or leader's delegate managers.

claims.claim: Engage administrators manage storyline settings.
claims.quote: Engage administrators manage storyline for their organizations in the Engage admin center.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no administrator view of the new saved audiences.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage saved audiences administrator limit audit. Opened leadership-identification and Storyline announcements; existing audience management is described, but no administrator view of new saved custom audiences is specified.

claims.where: controls[0].note; controls[2].note; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specifically documented how the existing audience and storyline-creator controls constrain the new targeting choices.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage flexible targeting Entire organization; Viva Engage Specify storyline creators settings API PowerShell Graph. Read Storyline announcements, leadership-identification and eac-storyline; general settings persist, but new custom-selection constraints are not specified.

claims.claim: The Manage leaders activity-log documentation does not explicitly include audiences selected at publish time.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage saved audiences administrator limit audit; Viva Engage leader audience management Microsoft Graph REST PowerShell API activity log. Read leadership-identification and Storyline announcements; no publish-time targeting log coverage is stated.

claims.claim: The described announcement workflow is a person composing and posting, not automated sending.
claims.quote: In Viva Engage, start your thread ... Confirm that the specified audience is the correct one to notify. ... Select Post to publish.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, first bullet
claims.claim: Every control the governance checklist asks readers to check has a controls-table row.
claims.quote: Check department, job title, country and manager values ... in Microsoft Entra ID or Organizational Data in Microsoft; the controls table covers leaders, delegates, storyline creators, the activity log and the targeting switch, but not organisational-data maintenance.
claims.fix: The organisational-data validation step has no corresponding control row. Remove this checklist bullet; retain the notice's organisational-data advice in Why it matters.
